{'content': '8月17日是印尼獨立81周年，多個在港印尼人團體今（23日）在銅鑼灣維園舉行慶祝活動，吸引眾多外傭參與，穿著傳統民俗服飾載歌載舞。同場有多個機構提供中醫、按摩、手工藝攤位，主辦單位指外傭作為香港家庭的照顧者，冀藉活動關懷他們的身心健康。', 'role': 'user'}

{'content': 'Indonesia declared independence from over 300 years of Dutch colonial rule in 1945, and August 17 marks Indonesian Independence Day, one of the most significant national holidays. With over 160,000 Indonesian domestic workers in Hong Kong, the Mission for Migrant Workers (MFMW), the Jaringan Buruh Migran Indonesia (JBMI) Hong Kong, and the Indonesian Migrant Workers Union (IMWU) have organised Independence Day celebrations every August for years, bringing together Indonesian domestic workers living far from home.', 'role': 'user'}

{'content': 'Indonesian domestic workers in traditional dress celebrate together, momentarily setting aside their worries.', 'role': 'user'}

{'content': "Siti, who has worked in Hong Kong for seven years, said most attendees at this year's event, again held in Victoria Park, are domestic workers whose daily work is highly stressful and who cannot celebrate on Independence Day itself. She was glad to have a chance to gather and enjoy a joyful time together as they would back home. Siti arrived today in traditional Balinese dress, while Via, also a domestic worker and standing beside her, was dressed up as Srikandi, the female general from East Javanese mythology, a character symbolising beauty and strength united in one figure, attracting many people to take photos with her.", 'role': 'user'}

{'content': 'Local and Indonesian groups set up booths to provide free medical services.', 'role': 'user'}

{'content': 'While the performance stage naturally drew the crowds, the on-site massage, health check and eye examination booths also had long queues. Volunteer masseuse Tini said they learn massage techniques in their spare time in the park, and use the event to practise their skills and serve the community, easing the chronic shoulder, back and head pain that many domestic workers suffer.', 'role': 'user'}

{'content': "Ms Tong Hiu-yan (唐曉昕), Community Relations Officer of co-organiser MFMW, said the cases the centre usually handles involving domestic workers are mostly work-related, yet domestic workers also seriously lack daily physical and mental care. She hopes the carnival can provide a 'Care for Caregiver' service, which has been supported by many local medical professionals over the years.", 'role': 'user'}

{'content': "Foreign domestic workers find it hard to speak up about their ailments, 'not wanting to be seen as difficult'.", 'role': 'user'}

{'content': "She explained that although labour laws guarantee domestic workers access to medical resources provided by their employers, and some employers do welcome domestic workers proactively voicing their health needs, many domestic workers 'don't want their employers to think they are difficult to deal with, and find it hard to judge what is just right', so they dare not speak up. The centre hopes the event helps domestic workers gain access to self-care opportunities and information, while also creating opportunities for them to care for one another, so that while living away from home, they can still be supported by a friendly community.", 'role': 'user'}

{'content': 'Continuing to follow up on cases involving domestic workers affected by the Wang Fuk Court fire.', 'role': 'user'}

{'content': 'Some domestic workers affected by the deadly Wang Fuk Court fire also attended today. Ms Tong said the affected workers still face various difficulties. For example, some have to travel across districts every day to care for their elderly employer who lives with them while another elderly family member is placed in a care home in Tai Po, while others must look after elderly persons who have developed emotional problems as a result of the fire. Some domestic workers have suffered mental distress to the point of depression, though they were fortunate that their employers showed understanding and agreed to terminate the contract so they could return home to recuperate. MFMW will continue to provide support to affected domestic workers and follow up on cases in need.', 'role': 'user'}
